title: Protecting the P-Trap Water Seal
description: A P-trap's primary job is keeping sewer gas out of living spaces by maintaining a continuous water seal. A critical professional tip is understanding trap seal degradation caused by self-siphonage and evaporation. If a trap crown weir is too close to a vertical drop or lacks proper venting, velocity will siphon the water seal completely dry after a flush. Ensure the fixture drain maintains proper distance to the vent stack and verify the trap seal depth stays within standard limits. In infrequently used fixtures, adding a trap seal primer prevents dry traps.
